documents.shipping-policy:
Effective date: January 2026
Last updated: January 2026
Version: 2.0

1. Scope and Agreement

This Shipping and Delivery Policy governs the purchase, dispatch, transit, and delivery of products sold by Buudy via our online storefront (us.buudy.com) and our checkout platform hosted on Whop Inc. By placing an order, the customer agrees to the fulfillment timelines, international logistics terms, and delivery protocols described below.

2. Order Processing and Delivery Timelines

Orders are fulfilled directly from our specialized international distribution facility. Every unit undergoes rigorous physical inspection, battery safety testing, and protective packaging prior to export.

Fulfillment Stage Operational Window Logistics Process
Order Processing & Quality Verification 1 to 2 business days Payment settlement, fraud analysis, electrical testing, protective packaging, and export sorting.
Air Linehaul Transit 4 to 6 business days Dedicated priority air freight directly to US customs entry hubs.
Customs Inward Processing (DDP) 1 to 2 business days Electronic pre-clearance under Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) protocols.
Final-Mile Courier Delivery 2 to 4 business days USPS Tracked, UPS, FedEx, or DHL Express with tracking and delivery confirmation.
Total Estimated Delivery Window 7 to 12 business days End-to-end tracked transit from warehouse dispatch to doorstep delivery.

Business days are defined as Monday through Friday, excluding United States federal holidays and internationally recognized public holidays. Standard transit estimates commence immediately upon the issuance of the carrier dispatch scan.

3. Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) Terms

All consignments shipped to customers in the United States are delivered strictly under Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) terms. The total price charged at checkout is inclusive of all customs clearance fees, import duties, linehaul charges, and applicable sales taxes calculated at checkout. Customers will not be subjected to doorstep collection surcharges, postal handling fees, or unexpected customs bills upon arrival. If an unexpected fee is presented by a carrier, customers should contact support@buudy.co.uk for immediate administrative resolution.

4. Shipment Tracking and Delivery Verification

Upon parcel dispatch from our export facility, an automated Dispatch Confirmation email will be delivered to the customer containing an active tracking link. International linehaul tracking numbers synchronize with domestic US carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx, or DHL Express) once entry processing is completed.

Delivery is deemed legally concluded when the carrier marks the parcel as delivered at the customer's nominated shipping address, substantiated by carrier electronic scanning data, GPS coordinate logging, or digital photographic delivery proof.

5. Customer Address Obligations

The customer is responsible for providing an accurate and deliverable shipping address, including any apartment, suite, or unit number, and a functioning mobile telephone number for courier delivery notifications. Address change requests must be submitted to support@buudy.co.uk within two (2) hours of order placement. Address changes cannot be processed once the warehouse has initiated picking, packing, or dispatch. If an order is returned to our international logistics depot due to an inaccurate address provided by the customer, recipient absence, or failure to collect from a local carrier facility, the customer may be liable for actual carrier return charges and reshipment expenses.

6. Delays, Transit Damage, and Missing Shipments

If tracking shows no movement for more than fifteen (15) consecutive business days, or if the shipment exceeds twenty-one (21) business days in transit, a carrier investigation will be initiated. If confirmed lost in transit, Buudy will provide an immediate replacement or issue a full refund via the original payment method through Whop.

In the event of shipping carton or product damage during transit, the customer must notify support@buudy.co.uk within forty-eight (48) hours of receipt, supplying clear photographs of the external packaging, courier shipping label, and damaged contents.

7. Contact and Administrative Disclosures

For shipping questions, tracking support, or delivery inquiries, contact:

Email: support@buudy.co.uk
Contact form: Contact Us
Customer service hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

Buudy Operations / xPage Drop LLC

131 Continental Dr Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States

Notice: This is a corporate administrative office only. It is not a warehouse, distribution facility, or customer return depot. Packages sent to this address will be rejected.
documents.return-policy:
Effective date: January 2026
Last updated: January 2026
Version: 2.0

1. Statutory Framework and Consumer Rights

This Return, Refund, and Cancellation Policy complies with United States Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines, the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) regarding express and implied warranties of merchantability and fitness, and applicable state consumer protection laws. Nothing in this policy limits or excludes your non-waivable statutory legal rights under federal or state law.

2. 14-Day Cancellation Right & Skincare Hygiene Exemption

Distance buyers retain the right to cancel their contract and return purchased merchandise within fourteen (14) calendar days of delivery without penalty, subject to the hygiene protection standards below.

Intimate Skincare Appliance Hygiene Exemption

The Buudy LED Face Mask, Buudy LED Torch, and associated skin-contact accessories are classified as intimate personal wellness and hygiene appliances that contact facial skin, biological secretions, and tissue. Under health, sanitation, and hygiene protections, products designed for direct skin contact cannot be accepted for return or resale once unsealed:

  • Intact Hygiene Seal (Eligible): If the protective packaging, holographic security seal, and shrink-wrap remain completely intact, unopened, and unhandled beyond external retail inspection, you may exercise your right to return or cancel within fourteen (14) calendar days of delivery.
  • Broken Hygiene Seal (Permanently Ineligible): Once the external protective shrink-wrap, box seal, or security sticker has been broken, peeled, opened, or tampered with, the product is permanently ineligible for return under change-of-mind rules due to personal health, sanitation, and hygiene protections, unless verified as defective or non-conforming under statutory warranty rules.

3. Defective, Damaged, or Non-Conforming Products

If your Buudy device develops an electrical fault, fails to charge, or fails to operate in accordance with published technical specifications, you are entitled to comprehensive warranty remedies under our commercial terms and state warranty statutes.

Product Issue Window Warranty & Statutory Entitlement Resolution Protocol
0 to 30 Days from Delivery 100% full refund or replacement. Contact customer support with video documentation demonstrating the electrical or physical failure.
31 Days to 6 Months Free repair or replacement. If the unit cannot be repaired or an equivalent replacement cannot be provided, a full refund without deduction will be issued.
6 Months to 12 Months Free service or replacement under Buudy 1-Year Limited Warranty. Covers manufacturing defects, abnormal battery degradation, and LED hardware failure.

Fault remedies do not cover user-inflicted damage, dropping, water ingress, cosmetic wear, unauthorized disassembly, or the use of incompatible high-voltage power adapters.

4. Promotional Bundles & Free Gift Returns

If you received a complimentary promotional gift (such as the Buudy LED Torch) as part of a qualifying promotional bundle and request a refund on the primary device, the promotional item must also be returned unopened in its original sealed condition. If retained or opened, its retail value ($69 USD) will be deducted from any final refund where permitted by law.

5. Return Logistics Protocol and RMA Procedure

Returns will not be accepted without prior written authorization. Unauthorized packages delivered to administrative addresses will be rejected.

  1. Submit a return request to support@buudy.co.uk or open an inquiry in the Whop Resolution Center within the relevant eligibility window.
  2. For change-of-mind returns (unopened items), provide photographs showing the unbroken, pristine condition of all factory seals and shrink-wrap.
  3. For fault claims, provide a detailed description and a video showing the device failing to function.
  4. Upon approval, an official Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Number and our designated return consolidation address will be provided.

Shipping Costs: For verified defective or misdescribed items, Buudy provides a prepaid domestic return shipping label. For unopened change-of-mind cancellations, the customer is responsible for tracked return postage.

6. Refund Settlement

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method through Whop within fourteen (14) days of our warehouse receiving the returned item or receiving verifiable tracking proof of return delivery. Standard outbound shipping fees paid at checkout are refunded for timely statutory cancellations; express shipping add-ons are non-refundable.

7. Order Cancellations Prior to Dispatch

Cancellation requests submitted within two (2) hours of placing an order will be processed if the order has not entered warehouse picking and export sorting. Once an order has entered fulfillment or dispatch, cancellation is no longer possible and the customer must follow the standard return procedure upon delivery.

8. Contact and Corporate Return Warning

For questions or assistance with returns, contact:

Email: support@buudy.co.uk
Contact form: Contact Us
Customer service hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

Buudy Operations / xPage Drop LLC

131 Continental Dr Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States

Warning: This is a corporate administrative office only. It is not a warehouse, fulfillment center, or return depot. Do not send returns to this address or to the return address printed on shipping labels without an official RMA number and designated return instructions from Buudy customer support.
documents.privacy-policy:
Effective date: January 2026
Last updated: January 2026
Version: 2.0

1. Data Controller and Principles

Buudy respects consumer privacy and processes personal information in accordance with applicable United States federal and state privacy statutes, including the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CCPA/CPRA). This notice details our data collection, management, and storage protocols when you interact with us.buudy.com and complete orders through our Merchant of Record and payment infrastructure partner, Whop Inc.

2. Personal Information Collected

We collect and process the following categories of personal information:

  • Identity & Contact Details: Full name, billing address, physical shipping address, email address, and telephone number.
  • Payment Telemetry: Whop Inc. processes and encrypts card credentials under PCI-DSS standards; Buudy retains transaction IDs, payment method metadata, and risk ratings, but never stores raw payment card numbers.
  • Order Logistics: Dispatch records, airway bills, carrier tracking codes, and proof of delivery images.
  • Technical Footprint: IP address, geolocation tags, browser user-agents, device fingerprints, and checkout timestamps collected for fraud monitoring and platform security.

3. Commercial Purposes for Processing

Personal information is processed for specific legitimate business purposes:

  1. Contractual Performance: Fulfilling customer orders, printing international airway bills, providing courier updates, and handling warranty claims.
  2. Legal & Tax Obligations: Satisfying customs declarations, accounting standards, and tax record retention requirements.
  3. Fraud Prevention & Dispute Defense: Preventing fraudulent transactions, managing business security, and defending against payment disputes.
  4. Direct Communications: Sending order confirmations, shipping notifications, and routine recommendations where explicitly opted-in.

4. Cross-Border Data Transfers

To fulfill purchases, customer delivery data (name, shipping address, contact phone) is transferred to our international warehousing and logistics partners in China, as well as to Whop Inc. systems in the United States. All cross-border transfers are conducted under strict commercial safeguards ensuring equivalent protection for your personal data.

5. Data Retention

Order records, communications, and invoice data are retained for up to six (6) years following transaction completion to satisfy statutory tax obligations, accounting compliance, and potential contractual dispute periods. After this retention window, data is permanently deleted or anonymized.

6. United States Consumer Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA)

Depending on your state of residence (including California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia, and Utah), you may possess specific statutory privacy rights:

  • Right to Know & Access: The right to request the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected about you.
  • Right to Correction: The right to request the correction of inaccurate personal information.
  • Right to Deletion: The right to request deletion of personal information, subject to statutory exceptions (such as order fulfillment, tax compliance, or fraud defense).
  • Right to Opt-Out of Sale or Sharing: Buudy does not sell personal information for monetary consideration. If any data transfer qualifies as "sharing" for cross-context behavioral advertising, you have the right to opt out.
  • Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you in pricing, service quality, or goods availability for exercising any statutory privacy rights.

To submit a privacy request, contact our privacy compliance desk at support@buudy.co.uk.

7. Children's Privacy

Our website and products are intended for adult consumers and are not directed to children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

8. Contact

For questions or requests regarding your personal information, contact:

Email: support@buudy.co.uk
Contact form: Contact Us
Customer service hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST

Buudy Operations / xPage Drop LLC

131 Continental Dr Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713, United States

documents.cookies-policy:
What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer by websites that you visit. Our site and our partners use cookies to enhance your experience, analyze traffic and for ad personalization and measurement. You can restrict or block cookies using your browser settings.

How to manage cookies

Some cookies are strictly necessary to allow you to use the website and its features, such as storing items in your basket. Without these cookies these features cannot be provided which may impair the functionality of the website.

You can select the cookies you would like this website to store on your device by changing your browser settings. Details on how to do this in each browser can be found on the ICO website:

https://ico.org.uk/your-data-matters/online/cookies/

You can install a browser add-on to opt-out of Google Analytics across all websites:

https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

Types of cookies

  • First-party cookies: Set by the website you have accessed to remember your preferences.
  • Third-party cookies: Set by a website other than the one you are accessing.
  • Session cookies: Temporary cookies deleted when you close your browser.
  • Persistent cookies: Remain on your device until erased or expired.

Cookies used on our website

Google Analytics: Collects information in anonymous form about how visitors use our site.

Google Ads: Improves advertising relevancy and reporting.

Google reCAPTCHA: Enhances security and fraud prevention.
